newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium's Sabena airline launches Internet site.
newsitem.headline: Belgium's Sabena airline launches Internet site.

text.p: Belgian national airline Sabena, following a growing trend by companies to be represented on the Worldwide Web, said on Friday it had set up a Website on the Internet.

"The Internet offers potential and easy access to information, which Sabena is keen to take advantage of. The airline sector is strongly present on the Internet in the form of information or the sale of airline tickets," Sabena said in a statement.
The site will offer flight details, historical background on Sabena, which is 49.5 percent owned by airliner Swissair, and information about promotional offers.
